observation: Participant brief prepared; required AGENTS.md read. Waiting for isolated desktop READY before interacting.

expectation: Start an original slow song from a blank canvas.
outcome: Blank project has prominent Choose instrument action.

expectation: Find a piano or soft string sound.
actions: Choose instrument; inspect three built-in cards; choose R1 Mini; open preset menu; select Pad · String Pad.
outcome: Found a plausible soft sound, but instrument cards do not describe sound families. Synth controls are unfamiliar; preset names make the choice possible. Browser reports 0 plug-ins despite three visible built-in instruments.

expectation: Double-click an empty pattern to write notes.
actions: Double-click center and lower body of pattern; Cancel rename; right-click.
outcome: Double-click opened Rename twice. Right-click reveals Edit notes and succeeds.

expectation: Use chord names to make C-F-G-C, one bar each.
actions: Generate > Chord; set length 1; set velocity 65; Add notes; Next range; change roots and repeat; Done.
outcome: Four visible triads with correct note names, and clip automatically extends to four bars. Next range is helpful.

expectation: C major chord notes should not look erroneous.
actions: Inspect Key menu after seeing red E, A and B notes; change Natural minor to Major.
outcome: Default key Natural minor conflicts visually with default generated Major triad. Inferred red means outside scale. Changed scale to Major. Also set tempo to 80 BPM through direct text entry.

expectation: Keys · Plucked Keys preset should supply a playable included keyboard sound.
actions: Add R1 Sampler; choose Keys · Plucked Keys; click Load sample.
outcome: Preset still displays No sample; Load sample opens empty Recent files. No included sound discovered. Cancelled and changed instrument to Mini, choosing Sync Lead.

expectation: Rename second track Melody after changing its instrument.
actions: Double-click track title (nothing visible); right-click Rename; type Melody; Apply name.
outcome: Track remains R1 Sampler. May require explicit field focus despite selected-looking text. Deferred recovery.

expectation: Draw a simple tune above chords.
actions: Edit notes; Pencil; drag first quarter note; click subsequent pitches, drag final half note.
outcome: 15 visible notes over four bars; previous drawn length reused; clip automatically grows. Keyboard pitch labels only C octaves, but inserted note labels confirm pitches. Playback transport advances. Sound not yet verified.

expectation: Add a spacious echo or reverb to melody.
actions: Instrument > Effects > Insert; choose R1 Spacer; Open editor; choose Tape Echo; drag Mix to 20%; enable Reverb.
outcome: One active R1 Spacer, Tape Echo modified with reverb enabled and 20% mix. Preset selection helpful. Some clicks missed because dialogs shifted positions between initial animation screenshot and settled UI; one opened Assistant accidentally, recovered with Back. No subjective effect sound confirmed.

actions: Played composition twice. Coordinator extracted actual recorded output.
outcome: UI displayed Audio output stream failed or disconnected banner. Coordinator measured a 12-second excerpt from 16:40:57 with peak -6.8 dBFS and mean -20.8 dBFS, verifying nonzero audio. No subjective listening claim. Audio error is environment-confounded.

expectation: Typing in a focused name field and Ctrl+S work.
actions: Retried track Properties Name, then used on-screen Keyboard to rename melody. Coordinator investigated focus issue.
outcome: On-screen keyboard successfully renamed melody. Coordinator confirmed Xvfb focus stayed on root after file picker due to no window manager, fixed driver focus restoration. Ctrl+S immediately worked afterward. Earlier ignored text and shortcuts are environment-confirmed, not product findings.

expectation: Save editable project and a playable audio file.
actions: Ctrl+S; save Soft-Song.rill in session exports; File > Export WAV; retain Mix/WAV/32-bit float/Follow audio setup/Arrangement/Include effect tails defaults; choose suggested Soft-Song.wav.
outcome: Title changed to Soft-Song. Export progress visible. Technical export settings unfamiliar; trusted defaults.

expectation: Confirm export and replay final arrangement.
actions: Observed Exported confirmation; switched to Arranger and pressed Play.
outcome: Two four-bar tracks visible and export confirmed. Final Play failed with Audio output stream failed or disconnected and Retry playback. Session ended; no sound-quality claim.
